title: How to link a PDF to a Static Page | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How to link a PDF to a Static Page Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000037888 Follow the steps in this article to learn how to add a PDF to a page. 1. Before linking the file to a static page, the file must be uploaded to the Media Manager. Learn more: How to Upload a File 2. Create or access the page intended for this purpose. Learn more: How to Create a Web Page 3. Navigate to My Content > Web Page Builder . 4. Locate the page and click Edit . Text Link Highlight the text and click Insert Link. Enter the path to the PDF file using only the relative part of the URL, for example: /images/pdf.pdf Image Link Click the image and follow the same steps as above to link the PDF. 6. Click Save Web Page: Finally, click View Page . For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
